verses.en: Then shall the kingdom of heaven be likened unto ten virgins, which took their lamps, and went forth to meet the bridegroom.
verses.pt: Então o Reino dos céus será semelhante a dez virgens, que tomaram suas lâmpadas, e saíram ao encontro do noivo.
verses.en_web: “Then the Kingdom of Heaven will be like ten virgins, who took their lamps, and went out to meet the bridegroom.
verses.en_bbe: Then the kingdom of heaven will be like ten virgins, the friends of the bride, who took their lights, and went out with the purpose of meeting the husband.

verses.en: And five of them were wise, and five were foolish.
verses.pt: E cinco delas eram prudentes, e cinco tolas.
verses.en_web: Five of them were foolish, and five were wise.
verses.en_bbe: And five of them were foolish, and five were wise.

verses.en: They that were foolish took their lamps, and took no oil with them:
verses.pt: As tolas, quando tomaram as suas lâmpadas, não tomaram azeite consigo.
verses.en_web: Those who were foolish, when they took their lamps, took no oil with them,
verses.en_bbe: For the foolish, when they took their lights, took no oil with them.

verses.en: But the wise took oil in their vessels with their lamps.
verses.pt: Mas as prudentes tomaram azeite nos seus frascos, com as suas lâmpadas.
verses.en_web: but the wise took oil in their vessels with their lamps.
verses.en_bbe: But the wise took oil in their vessels with their lights.

verses.en: While the bridegroom tarried, they all slumbered and slept.
verses.pt: O noivo demorou, por isso todas cochilaram e adormeceram.
verses.en_web: Now while the bridegroom delayed, they all slumbered and slept.
verses.en_bbe: Now the husband was a long time in coming, and they all went to sleep.

verses.en: And at midnight there was a cry made, Behold, the bridegroom cometh; go ye out to meet him.
verses.pt: Mas à meia-noite houve um grito: “Eis que vem o noivo! Ide ao seu encontro!”.
verses.en_web: But at midnight there was a cry, ‘Behold! The bridegroom is coming! Come out to meet him!’
verses.en_bbe: But in the middle of the night there is a cry, The husband comes! Go out to him.

verses.en: Then all those virgins arose, and trimmed their lamps.
verses.pt: Então todas aquelas virgens se levantaram, e prepararam suas lâmpadas.
verses.en_web: Then all those virgins arose, and trimmed their lamps.
verses.en_bbe: Then all those virgins got up, and made ready their lights.

verses.en: And the foolish said unto the wise, Give us of your oil; for our lamps are gone out.
verses.pt: E as tolas disseram às prudentes: “Dai-nos do vosso azeite, porque as nossas lâmpadas estão se apagando”.
verses.en_web: The foolish said to the wise, ‘Give us some of your oil, for our lamps are going out.’
verses.en_bbe: And the foolish said to the wise, Give us of your oil; for our lights are going out.

verses.en: But the wise answered, saying, Not so; lest there be not enough for us and you: but go ye rather to them that sell, and buy for yourselves.
verses.pt: Mas as prudentes responderam: “ Não,para que não falte a nós e a vós; em vez disso, ide aos vendedores, e comprai para vós mesmas”.
verses.en_web: But the wise answered, saying, ‘What if there isn’t enough for us and you? You go rather to those who sell, and buy for yourselves.’
verses.en_bbe: But the wise made answer, saying, There may not be enough for us and you; it would be better for you to go to the traders and get oil for yourselves.

verses.en: And while they went to buy, the bridegroom came; and they that were ready went in with him to the marriage: and the door was shut.
verses.pt: Enquanto elas foram comprar, veio o noivo. As que estavam preparadas entraram com ele à festa do casamento, e fechou-se a porta.
verses.en_web: While they went away to buy, the bridegroom came, and those who were ready went in with him to the marriage feast, and the door was shut.
verses.en_bbe: And while they went to get oil, the master came; and those who were ready went in with him to the feast: and the door was shut.

verses.en: Afterward came also the other virgins, saying, Lord, Lord, open to us.
verses.pt: Depois vieram também as outras virgens, dizendo: “Senhor, Senhor, abre-nos!”
verses.en_web: Afterward the other virgins also came, saying, ‘Lord, Lord, open to us.’
verses.en_bbe: After that the other virgins came, saying, Lord, Lord, let us in.

verses.en: But he answered and said, Verily I say unto you, I know you not.
verses.pt: Mas ele respondeu: “Em verdade vos digo que não vos conheço”.
verses.en_web: But he answered, ‘Most certainly I tell you, I don’t know you.’
verses.en_bbe: But he made answer and said, Truly I say to you, I have no knowledge of you.

verses.en: Watch therefore, for ye know neither the day nor the hour wherein the Son of man cometh.
verses.pt: Portanto, vigiai, porque não sabeis o dia nem a hora em que o Filho do homem virá.
verses.en_web: Watch therefore, for you don’t know the day nor the hour in which the Son of Man is coming.
verses.en_bbe: Keep watch, then, because you are not certain of the day or of the hour.

verses.en: For the kingdom of heaven is as a man travelling into a far country, who called his own servants, and delivered unto them his goods.
verses.pt: Pois é como um homem, que partindo para fora do país, chamou seus servos, e lhes entregou os seus bens.
verses.en_web: “For it is like a man, going into another country, who called his own servants, and entrusted his goods to them.
verses.en_bbe: For it is as when a man, about to take a journey, got his servants together, and gave them his property.

verses.en: And unto one he gave five talents, to another two, and to another one; to every man according to his several ability; and straightway took his journey.
verses.pt: E a um deu cinco talentos, a outro dois, e ao terceiro um, a cada um conforme a sua habilidade, e logo depois partiu em viagem.
verses.en_web: To one he gave five talents, to another two, to another one; to each according to his own ability. Then he went on his journey.
verses.en_bbe: And to one he gave five talents, to another two, to another one; to everyone as he was able; and he went on his journey.

verses.en: Then he that had received the five talents went and traded with the same, and made them other five talents.
verses.pt: Em seguida, o que havia recebido cinco talentos foi fazer negócios com eles, e obteve outros cinco talentos.
verses.en_web: Immediately he who received the five talents went and traded with them, and made another five talents.
verses.en_bbe: Straight away he who had been given the five talents went and did trade with them, and made five more.

verses.en: And likewise he that had received two, he also gained other two.
verses.pt: E, semelhantemente, o que havia recebido dois ganhou também outros dois.
verses.en_web: In the same way, he also who got the two gained another two.
verses.en_bbe: In the same way he who had been given the two got two more.

verses.en: But he that had received one went and digged in the earth, and hid his lord’s money.
verses.pt: Mas o que tinha recebido um foi cavar a terra, e escondeu o dinheiro do seu senhor.
verses.en_web: But he who received the one talent went away and dug in the earth, and hid his lord’s money.
verses.en_bbe: But he who was given the one went away and put it in a hole in the earth, and kept his lord's money in a secret place.

verses.en: After a long time the lord of those servants cometh, and reckoneth with them.
verses.pt: Muito tempo depois, o senhor daqueles servos veio fazer contas com eles.
verses.en_web: “Now after a long time the lord of those servants came, and reconciled accounts with them.
verses.en_bbe: Now after a long time the lord of those servants comes, and makes up his account with them.

verses.en: And so he that had received five talents came and brought other five talents, saying, Lord, thou deliveredst unto me five talents: behold, I have gained beside them five talents more.
verses.pt: O que havia recebido cinco talentos chegou trazendo-lhe outros cinco talentos, e disse: ”Senhor, cinco talentos me entregaste, eis que ganhei com eles outros cinco talentos”.
verses.en_web: He who received the five talents came and brought another five talents, saying, ‘Lord, you delivered to me five talents. Behold, I have gained another five talents besides them.’
verses.en_bbe: And he who had the five talents came with his other five talents, saying, Lord, you gave into my care five talents: see, I have got five more.

verses.en: His lord said unto him, Well done, thou good and faithful servant: thou hast been faithful over a few things, I will make thee ruler over many things: enter thou into the joy of thy lord.
verses.pt: E o seu senhor lhe disse: “ Muito bem, servo bom e fiel! Sobre o pouco foste fiel, sobre o muito te porei; entra na alegria do teu senhor”.
verses.en_web: “His lord said to him, ‘Well done, good and faithful servant. You have been faithful over a few things, I will set you over many things. Enter into the joy of your lord.’
verses.en_bbe: His lord said to him, Well done, good and true servant: you have been true in a small thing, I will give you control over great things: take your part in the joy of your lord.

verses.en: He also that had received two talents came and said, Lord, thou deliveredst unto me two talents: behold, I have gained two other talents beside them.
verses.pt: E chegando-se também o que havia recebido dois talentos, disse: “Senhor, dois talentos me entregaste, eis que ganhei com eles outros dois talentos”.
verses.en_web: “He also who got the two talents came and said, ‘Lord, you delivered to me two talents. Behold, I have gained another two talents besides them.’
verses.en_bbe: And he who had the two talents came and said, Lord, you gave into my care two talents: see, I have got two more.

verses.en: His lord said unto him, Well done, good and faithful servant; thou hast been faithful over a few things, I will make thee ruler over many things: enter thou into the joy of thy lord.
verses.pt: Seu senhor lhe disse: “ Muito bem, servo bom e fiel! Sobre o pouco foste fiel, sobre o muito te porei; entra na alegria do teu senhor”.
verses.en_web: “His lord said to him, ‘Well done, good and faithful servant. You have been faithful over a few things, I will set you over many things. Enter into the joy of your lord.’
verses.en_bbe: His lord said to him, Well done, good and true servant: you have been true in a small thing, I will give you control over great things: take your part in the joy of your lord.

verses.en: Then he which had received the one talent came and said, Lord, I knew thee that thou art an hard man, reaping where thou hast not sown, and gathering where thou hast not strawed:
verses.pt: Mas, chegando também o que havia recebido um talento, disse: “Senhor, eu te conhecia, que és homem duro, que colhes onde não semeaste, e ajuntas onde não espalhaste;
verses.en_web: “He also who had received the one talent came and said, ‘Lord, I knew you that you are a hard man, reaping where you did not sow, and gathering where you did not scatter.
verses.en_bbe: And he who had had the one talent came and said, Lord, I had knowledge that you are a hard man, getting in grain where you have not put seed, and making profits for which you have done no work:

verses.en: And I was afraid, and went and hid thy talent in the earth: lo, there thou hast that is thine.
verses.pt: E eu, atemorizado, fui e escondi o teu talento na terra; eis aqui tens o que é teu”.
verses.en_web: I was afraid, and went away and hid your talent in the earth. Behold, you have what is yours.’
verses.en_bbe: And I was in fear, and went away, and put your talent in the earth: here is what is yours.

verses.en: His lord answered and said unto him, Thou wicked and slothful servant, thou knewest that I reap where I sowed not, and gather where I have not strawed:
verses.pt: Porém seu senhor lhe respondeu: “Servo mau e preguiçoso! Sabias que colho onde não semeei, e ajunto onde não espalhei.
verses.en_web: “But his lord answered him, ‘You wicked and slothful servant. You knew that I reap where I didn’t sow, and gather where I didn’t scatter.
verses.en_bbe: But his lord in answer said to him, You are a bad and unready servant; if you had knowledge that I get in grain where I did not put seed, and make profits for which I have done no work,

verses.en: Thou oughtest therefore to have put my money to the exchangers, and then at my coming I should have received mine own with usury.
verses.pt: Devias, portanto, ter depositado o meu dinheiro com os banqueiros e, quando eu voltasse, receberia o que é meu com juros.
verses.en_web: You ought therefore to have deposited my money with the bankers, and at my coming I should have received back my own with interest.
verses.en_bbe: Why, then, did you not put my money in the bank, and at my coming I would have got back what is mine with interest?

verses.en: Take therefore the talent from him, and give it unto him which hath ten talents.
verses.pt: Por isso, tirai dele o talento, e dai-o ao que tem dez talentos”.
verses.en_web: Take away therefore the talent from him, and give it to him who has the ten talents.
verses.en_bbe: Take away, then, his talent and give it to him who has the ten talents.

verses.en: For unto every one that hath shall be given, and he shall have abundance: but from him that hath not shall be taken away even that which he hath.
verses.pt: Pois a todo aquele que tiver, lhe será dado, e terá em abundância; porém ao que não tiver, até o que tem lhe será tirado.
verses.en_web: For to everyone who has will be given, and he will have abundance, but from him who doesn’t have, even that which he has will be taken away.
verses.en_bbe: For to everyone who has will be given, and he will have more: but from him who has not, even what he has will be taken away.

verses.en: And cast ye the unprofitable servant into outer darkness: there shall be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
verses.pt: “E lançai o servo inútil às trevas de fora (ali haverá pranto e ranger de dentes)”.
verses.en_web: Throw out the unprofitable servant into the outer darkness, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.’
verses.en_bbe: And put out the servant who is of no profit into the outer dark: there will be weeping and cries of sorrow.

verses.en: When the Son of man shall come in his glory, and all the holy angels with him, then shall he sit upon the throne of his glory:
verses.pt: E quando o Filho do homem vier em sua glória, e todos os santos anjos com ele, então ele se assentará sobre o trono de sua glória.
verses.en_web: “But when the Son of Man comes in his glory, and all the holy angels with him, then he will sit on the throne of his glory.
verses.en_bbe: But when the Son of man comes in his glory, and all the angels with him, then will he be seated in his glory:

verses.en: And before him shall be gathered all nations: and he shall separate them one from another, as a shepherd divideth his sheep from the goats:
verses.pt: E serão ajuntadas diante dele todas as nações, e separará as pessoas umas das outras, assim como o pastor separa as ovelhas dos bodes.
verses.en_web: Before him all the nations will be gathered, and he will separate them one from another, as a shepherd separates the sheep from the goats.
verses.en_bbe: And before him all the nations will come together; and they will be parted one from another, as the sheep are parted from the goats by the keeper.

verses.en: And he shall set the sheep on his right hand, but the goats on the left.
verses.pt: E porá as ovelhas à sua direita, porém os bodes à esquerda.
verses.en_web: He will set the sheep on his right hand, but the goats on the left.
verses.en_bbe: And he will put the sheep on his right, but the goats on the left.

verses.en: Then shall the King say unto them on his right hand, Come, ye blessed of my Father, inherit the kingdom prepared for you from the foundation of the world:
verses.pt: Então o Rei dirá o rei aos que estiverem à sua direita: “Vinde, benditos de meu Pai! Herdai o Reino que está preparado para vós desde a fundação do mundo.
verses.en_web: Then the King will tell those on his right hand, ‘Come, blessed of my Father, inherit the Kingdom prepared for you from the foundation of the world;
verses.en_bbe: Then will the King say to those on his right, Come, you who have the blessing of my Father, into the kingdom made ready for you before the world was:

verses.en: For I was an hungred, and ye gave me meat: I was thirsty, and ye gave me drink: I was a stranger, and ye took me in:
verses.pt: Pois tive fome, e me destes de comer; tive sede, e me destes de beber; fui forasteiro, e me acolhestes;
verses.en_web: for I was hungry, and you gave me food to eat. I was thirsty, and you gave me drink. I was a stranger, and you took me in.
verses.en_bbe: For I was in need of food, and you gave it to me: I was in need of drink, and you gave it to me: I was wandering, and you took me in;

verses.en: Naked, and ye clothed me: I was sick, and ye visited me: I was in prison, and ye came unto me.
verses.pt: estive nu, e me vestistes; estive doente, e cuidastes de mim; estive na prisão, e me visitastes”.
verses.en_web: I was naked, and you clothed me. I was sick, and you visited me. I was in prison, and you came to me.’
verses.en_bbe: I had no clothing, and you gave it to me: when I was ill, or in prison, you came to me.

verses.en: Then shall the righteous answer him, saying, Lord, when saw we thee an hungred, and fed thee? or thirsty, and gave thee drink?
verses.pt: Então os justos lhe perguntarão: “Senhor, quando te vimos com fome, e te demos de comer, ou com sede, e te demos de beber?
verses.en_web: “Then the righteous will answer him, saying, ‘Lord, when did we see you hungry, and feed you; or thirsty, and give you a drink?
verses.en_bbe: Then will the upright make answer to him, saying, Lord, when did we see you in need of food, and give it to you? or in need of drink, and give it to you?

verses.en: When saw we thee a stranger, and took thee in? or naked, and clothed thee?
verses.pt: E quando te vimos forasteiro, e te acolhemos, ou nu, e te vestimos?
verses.en_web: When did we see you as a stranger, and take you in; or naked, and clothe you?
verses.en_bbe: And when did we see you wandering, and take you in? or without clothing, and give it to you?

verses.en: Or when saw we thee sick, or in prison, and came unto thee?
verses.pt: E quando te vimos doente, ou na prisão, e viemos te visitar?”
verses.en_web: When did we see you sick, or in prison, and come to you?’
verses.en_bbe: And when did we see you ill, or in prison, and come to you?

verses.en: And the King shall answer and say unto them, Verily I say unto you, Inasmuch as ye have done it unto one of the least of these my brethren, ye have done it unto me.
verses.pt: E o Rei lhes responderá: “Em verdade vos digo que, todas as vezes que fizestes a um destes menores dos meus irmãos, fizestes a mim”.
verses.en_web: “The King will answer them, ‘Most certainly I tell you, because you did it to one of the least of these my brothers, you did it to me.’
verses.en_bbe: And the King will make answer and say to them, Truly I say to you, Because you did it to the least of these my brothers, you did it to me.

verses.en: Then shall he say also unto them on the left hand, Depart from me, ye cursed, into everlasting fire, prepared for the devil and his angels:
verses.pt: Então dirá também aos que estiverem à esquerda: “Apartai-vos de mim, malditos, ao fogo eterno, preparado para o Diabo e os seus anjos.
verses.en_web: Then he will say also to those on the left hand, ‘Depart from me, you cursed, into the eternal fire which is prepared for the devil and his angels;
verses.en_bbe: Then will he say to those on the left, Go from me, you cursed ones, into the eternal fire which is ready for the Evil One and his angels:

verses.en: For I was an hungred, and ye gave me no meat: I was thirsty, and ye gave me no drink:
verses.pt: Pois tive fome, e não me destes de comer; tive sede, e não me destes de beber.
verses.en_web: for I was hungry, and you didn’t give me food to eat; I was thirsty, and you gave me no drink;
verses.en_bbe: For I was in need of food, and you gave it not to me; I was in need of drink, and you gave it not to me:

verses.en: I was a stranger, and ye took me not in: naked, and ye clothed me not: sick, and in prison, and ye visited me not.
verses.pt: Fui forasteiro, e não me acolhestes; estive nu, e não me vestistes; estive doente, e na prisão, e não me visitastes.
verses.en_web: I was a stranger, and you didn’t take me in; naked, and you didn’t clothe me; sick, and in prison, and you didn’t visit me.’
verses.en_bbe: I was wandering, and you took me not in; without clothing, and you gave me no clothing; ill, and in prison, and you came not to me.

verses.en: Then shall they also answer him, saying, Lord, when saw we thee an hungred, or athirst, or a stranger, or naked, or sick, or in prison, and did not minister unto thee?
verses.pt: Então também eles lhe perguntarão: “Senhor, quando te vimos com fome, ou com sede, ou forasteiro, ou nu, ou doente, ou na prisão, e não te servimos?”
verses.en_web: “Then they will also answer, saying, ‘Lord, when did we see you hungry, or thirsty, or a stranger, or naked, or sick, or in prison, and didn’t help you?’
verses.en_bbe: Then will they make answer, saying, Lord, when did we see you in need of food or drink, or wandering, or without clothing, or ill, or in prison, and did not take care of you?

verses.en: Then shall he answer them, saying, Verily I say unto you, Inasmuch as ye did it not to one of the least of these, ye did it not to me.
verses.pt: Então ele lhes responderá, dizendo: “Em verdade vos digo que, todas as vezes que não fizestes a um destes menores, não fizestes a mim”.
verses.en_web: “Then he will answer them, saying, ‘Most certainly I tell you, because you didn’t do it to one of the least of these, you didn’t do it to me.’
verses.en_bbe: Then will he make answer to them, saying, Truly I say to you, Because you did it not to the least of these, you did it not to me.

verses.en: And these shall go away into everlasting punishment: but the righteous into life eternal.
verses.pt: E estes irão ao tormento eterno, porém os justos à vida eterna.
verses.en_web: These will go away into eternal punishment, but the righteous into eternal life.”
verses.en_bbe: And these will go away into eternal punishment; but the upright into eternal life.
